scope: Composed JavaScript race with original physics, AI, contacts, bonuses and timers. A test-only route follower supplies ordinary analog controls. No poses, velocities, triggers, pickups, timers, or physics tables are changed. This is not an original Windows full-process comparison or a full-campaign UI run.
testDriverPolicy: Recorded policyProfiles adjust only test driver speed/lookahead/gains by sector. Recorded centerSections use ordinary steering toward original PMP centerline lookahead; other sections retain lane priorities and optional authored waypoint goals by sector (waypointSchedule recorded) supplied only to the test controller, no game pickup/trigger calls; fixed authored-link direction priority; original linked-road follower with its optional detour planner disabled; production obstacles and collision responses remain active. Ordinary inputs only.
linkedNodePolicy: Shortest rail-prechecked original DMP link, from canonical test helper; private profiles change only driver goals/gains.
